name: Thirty Day Habit Challenge
description: Creates a complete 30-day habit challenge with daily commitment schedules, progressive difficulty, milestone markers, and tracking sheets. Gathers the user's target habit and starting level, then produces a day-by-day challenge plan with specific daily actions, rest days, and completion criteria. Use when the user asks about 30-day challenges, month-long habit experiments, daily commitment plans, or structured habit-building programs. Do NOT use for clinical behavior modification, addiction recovery programs, or extreme fitness challenges requiring medical clearance.
